limitations.blocked_by: PLA printed threads: the camera's 1/4-20 socket is metal, and a printed screw carries the entire camera load — it would strip or shear, especially with only ~10 mm of length to work with
limitations.wanted: 3D-printing the 1/4-20 camera screw itself (the "part that screws in")
limitations.why: You asked to print both parts; instead the salvaged steel webcam-mount bolt does that job, which is far safer

limitations.blocked_by: The measurement requests only ever returned a description of the clamp ("jaws with angled lips, knob, drops in from above"), never numbers for the jaw opening, lip height, or platform depth
limitations.wanted: Exact dimensions of the tripod clamp's jaw opening, lip height, and platform depth
limitations.why: To size the plate's width, depth, and thickness to your specific clamp instead of guessing; the design compensates with a sand-to-fit step
